smoke_test: ./mvnw -B verify passes: the project builds, the Spring context boots against a Testcontainers PostgreSQL, Flyway applies all migrations, the module-boundary test and the (otherwise empty) test suite pass, and ./mvnw -B spotless:check passes

tasks.title: Create the Maven Spring Boot project, root package and entry point
tasks.dod: Maven Wrapper committed; pom.xml on Java 21 and Spring Boot 4.1.x (pin the current GA patch) with spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-validation, spring-boot-starter-data-jdbc, postgresql driver, flyway-core + flyway-database-postgresql, spring-modulith-starter-core; TrimlyApplication in io.github.igorermolenko.trimly; empty module packages link/ and redirect/ (package-info.java each) and shared/ with a @RestControllerAdvice returning RFC 9457 ProblemDetail and a UUIDv7 ID generator; application.yml holds non-secret defaults only and reads SPRING_DATASOURCE_* from env; `./mvnw -B package -DskipTests` succeeds

tasks.title: Wire the test harness, module-boundary test and formatting check

tasks.title: Set up Flyway with an initial baseline migration
tasks.dod: src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__baseline.sql exists (no feature tables; feature schemas come from data-model); Flyway applies it cleanly on a fresh Testcontainers PostgreSQL during ApplicationBootIT; re-running on an already-migrated database is a no-op (Flyway is forward-only, so there is no down migration)

tasks.title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow
